sections.Profile:
"Silver Falls" is a pinball simulation game developed by Nick and Sophia Baldridge for the Multimorphic P3 platform, released in 2021. ​ The game integrates character customization and simulation elements, allowing players to create unique avatars by choosing from 24 different characters, each with three appearance options and six voices, resulting in 432 possible combinations. Players earn in-game currency, known as PinBucks, by hitting various shots and targets. These PinBucks can be spent in the in-game shop to purchase furniture and appliances for the player's virtual home. Completing room upgrades unlocks timed modes and new challenges, encouraging progression through different rooms and jobs within the game. ​ The game features a unique chillhop soundtrack composed by Scott Danesi, enhancing its relaxed and immersive atmosphere. "Silver Falls" requires the Heist playfield module to play and is available for purchase through Multimorphic's online store. ​
